blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The initial investigation into the collapse of a bridge under construction in Gandara, Samar, has pointed to human error after the contractor admitted that a roller attachment had been removed without approval, Public Works Secretary Giovanni “Banoy” Lopez said. Lopez said the incident happened on Tuesday, when two girders of the P512-million concrete bridge collapsed. Upon receiving the report, Lopez immediately deployed a technical team to determine the cause of the incident, including whether it stemmed from a design flaw. “When I received the news, I immediately sent a technical team to determine what had happened and whether […]...
